note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'. Azure DevOps objects that need the portal are listed as owner steps in prepare.
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin

bash -c 'for E in lab prod; do az group create -n rg-contoso-$E -l swedencentral --tags workload=contoso environment=$E owner=platform-team -o none; az deployment group create -g rg-contoso-$E --name governance --parameters ../02-cloud-architecture/infra/env/governance.bicepparam --parameters allowedLocations="[\"swedencentral\"]" -o none; done'
if (-not (az devops project list --query "value[?name=='contoso-platform'].name | [0]" -o tsv)) { az devops project create --name contoso-platform --visibility private --process Agile -o none }

az repos import create --git-source-url https://github.com/devladlog/mg-lab --repository contoso-platform -o none   # imports branch main; if the GitHub repo is private the owner adds a GitHub service connection first

# owner (browser, labadmin): Project settings > Service connections > New > Azure Resource Manager > App registration (automatic) > Workload identity federation, scope = resource group rg-contoso-lab, name sc-contoso-lab; same for rg-contoso-prod as sc-contoso-prod. Do NOT tick 'Grant access to all pipelines'; no checks on sc-contoso-prod
# owner (portal): per connection add Role Based Access Control Administrator on its resource group, constrained to Storage Blob Data Reader and Key Vault Secrets User
# owner (browser): Pipelines > Environments: contoso-lab (no checks); contoso-prod with Approvals (Alex Demo or labadmin) and Exclusive lock

az pipelines create --name contoso-workload --repository contoso-platform --repository-type tfsgit --branch main --yaml-path /series/azure/episodes/03-azure-devops-ci-cd/pipelines/azure-pipelines.yml --skip-first-run -o none
# owner (browser): Repos > Branches > main > Branch policies > Build validation = contoso-workload (automatic, required)

az pipelines run --name contoso-workload --branch main -o none   # first run: authorize the service connections and environments when prompted; wait about 10-15 minutes until ci, lab and prod_plan are green and prod shows Waiting

screens.name: pipeline-run
steps: Open the latest run on main
Show the run summary with the stages ci, lab, prod_plan green and prod Waiting with the Review button
Optional extra shot: the 'This pipeline needs permission' prompt from the first run
mask: organization and project names in the URL and breadcrumb
user names and avatars except the fictional approver

screens.name: tests-tab
steps: Show 66 passed (pytest 44 + 15 merged into one run, xUnit 7), 0 failed, with the two test run titles visible
If the count differs, tell the episode builder to update the narration number
mask: organization and project names in the URL and breadcrumb
user names and avatars except the fictional approver

screens.name: approval
steps: Open the Extensions tab and show the summary 'What-if gate: rg-contoso-prod: GO' (all Create on the empty prod group)
Go back to the run summary and click Review on the prod stage to show the approval dialog with Approve and Reject
Click Reject with the comment 'demo: prod stays empty'
Download the whatif-prod_plan artifact and hand whatif.json to the episode builder (subscription ID zeroed) as tests/fixtures/whatif-real-prod.json
mask: organization and project names in the URL and breadcrumb
user names and avatars except the fictional approver
screens.note: Sign in as alex.demo in a second browser profile, or keep labadmin as approver if the requester-cannot-approve option is off.

screens.name: environment-history
steps: Show the Deployments tab with the rejected run listed
Open Approvals and checks and show Approvals and Exclusive lock (do not open the service connection Edit pane)
mask: organization and project names in the URL and breadcrumb
user names and avatars except the fictional approver

teardown: if ($kv) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 60; az keyvault purge --name $kv }   # lab vault has purge protection off (episode 2)
$pid_ = az devops project show --project contoso-platform --query id -o tsv; if ($pid_) { az devops project delete --id $pid_ --yes }   # removes repo, pipeline, environments and service connections

az ad app list --filter "startswith(displayName,'devladlog-contoso-platform')" --query "[].id" -o tsv | ForEach-Object { az ad app delete --id $_ }   # app registrations made by the automatic service connections
